name: recovery
description: F6 (SPEC section 3, S6): F1 tallykit at a smaller size. A Python package (recoverkit) of four independent modules, three agents: a owns ranges and will ask c what the bit numbering of masks is, b owns wrap and pairs, c (the victim) owns bits and the duty to answer a. The harness kills c with SIGKILL while it holds a claim (K arms) or a board line marked working (B1) with its module edited and not committed and a's question unanswered; nobody is told. The numbering is recorded in docs/FORMATS.md, so the survivors can answer from the repository once they notice.
